skills.name: Wall Plumb
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 3 points.

skills.name: Level
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 2 points.

skills.name: Story Height
skills.criteria: Tolerance: 1/8” in 4 ft. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation. Measure at 1 point.

skills.name: Wall Length
skills.criteria: End-to-end walls: within 3/8”; Adjacent walls: exact. Deduct 1 pt per 1/16” deviation.

skills.name: Voids
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt for every void in mortar joints.

skills.name: Time
skills.criteria: Full score if completed in time limit. Deduct 1 pt per minute over.

skills.name: Brick/Block Technique
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per instance: relayed blocks, exposed sashes, smearing, over-tapping, redundant leveling.

skills.name: Safety Practices
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per issue: no PPE, unsafe behavior (e.g., jumping walls), breaking down walls.

skills.name: Overall Appearance
skills.criteria: Deduct 1 pt per: undersized/oversized joints, sloppy tooling, broken/protruding blocks.

skills.name: Hammer Cuts
skills.criteria: Accuracy and cleanliness of hammer cuts.

skills.name: Q1. Mortar types
skills.criteria: Name the five ASTM mortar types (M, S, N, O, K) and rank them from highest to lowest compressive strength. 1 pt per type, 1 pt for correct order.

skills.name: Q2. Bond patterns
skills.criteria: Name three common bond patterns and describe the brick arrangement of each. 2 pts per pattern.

skills.name: Q3. Course height
skills.criteria: A wall is laid with 8 in. nominal courses (joint included). How tall is a 10-course wall? 3 pts for 80 in., 2 pts for showing work.

skills.name: Q4. Tools
skills.criteria: Give the use of each: trowel, jointer, level, plumb bob, line pin, brick hammer. 1 pt each.

skills.name: Q5. Safety
skills.criteria: List three pieces of required PPE and one hazard each protects against. 1 pt per item, 1 pt per hazard.

skills.name: Q6. Joint types
skills.criteria: Explain the difference between a concave and a raked joint, and which sheds water better. 5 pts.

skills.name: Q7. Block count
skills.criteria: How many 16 x 8 in. blocks are needed for a 12 ft x 4 ft wall, ignoring waste? 5 pts for 54 blocks, 3 pts for showing work.

skills.name: Q8. Mixing mortar
skills.criteria: Describe the steps to hand-mix a batch of mortar, including tempering. 1 pt per correct step, up to 8.
